prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square stylized storefront visual under a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds. Show a front-facing CellphoneS branch with a giant white cellphoneS wordmark on a bold red facade and a smaller roof sign above it. Add a black category bar reading 'ĐIỆN THOẠI', 'MÁY TÍNH', 'PHỤ KIỆN', and 'GIA DỤNG' with icons. Keep the glass entrance and interior product displays visible. Add a rounded green address banner at the bottom with a map pin and the text 'Số 4 và 6 Lê Thái Tổ, Khóm 2, Long Châu, Vĩnh Long'. Technical style: stylized 3D storefront brand visual, bright sunny daylight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
